messages:
maria: Heads-up — I've been seeing steady memory growth on kv-shard hosts for the long-context workload (~20k tokens). Eviction counters look steady (~5/s) but RSS climbs ~300MB/hr :eyes:

maria: Quick profile snapshot I pulled: top resident segments: seg_123=1.2GB, seg_47=800MB. free_fragment_ratio=14%. alloc_churn=high. No obvious spike in evictions or hits/misses to explain it.

aj: Interesting. Steady evictions + rising RSS screams fragmentation or allocator not returning memory to OS. Do we even export fragmentation metrics per-shard?

maria: Nope — our current metrics are pretty limited: kv_evictions_total, kv_hits_total, kv_misses_total, kv_residency_fraction, kv_resident_bytes. No frag/compaction/reuse metrics.

deepak: We should add: kv_frag_ratio (free_bytes / total_cached_bytes), kv_compaction_runs_total, kv_reuse_within_10s_ratio, and kv_allocated_vs_rss_bytes. Those will help disambiguate allocator overhead vs logical leakage.

linh: Also propose reservoir sampling of evicted keys so we can inspect sizes/ages/shape offline. Something like exposing evicted_sample{shard,model,segment} with a 5/min sample. That would let us check if a few huge keys cause hot segments.

maria: I ran a Prometheus ad-hoc that looked weird:
```
# per-shard eviction rate normalized by residency
sum by (shard) (rate(kv_evictions_total[5m]))
/
avg by (shard) (kv_residency_fraction)
```
Shard A shows low evictions but dropping residency fraction vs other shards.

aj: That could be hotspotting — a couple huge segments keep growing so global counters look fine but local pressure differs. Dashboard panel idea: top-10 segments by kv_resident_bytes (stacked) + reclaimed_bytes over time.

infra-bot: deploy queued: metrics/kv-fragmentation-metrics -> staging (PR #4021) :rocket:

deepak: For dashboards add percentiles for reuse/fragment age: p50/p90/p99(kv_reuse_latency_seconds), p50/p90/p99(kv_fragment_age_seconds). Also a timeseries for kv_compaction_runs_total (rate) to correlate with RSS drop events.

maria: One more thing — allocator doesn't seem to return memory to OS between compactions. If frag_ratio > 20% and compaction rate is low we probably need an aggressive compaction trigger (or tune jemalloc).

linh: Suggest alert config: if kv_frag_ratio > 0.25 for 30m AND rss_growth_rate > 50MB/h -> page eng-runtime oncall. Also add a less-severe warn for >15% frag for 1h.

aj: I'll start a dashboard mock and add the queries. Also want to add a lightweight synthetic: spawn a 20k token chat pinned for 10m and interleave short chats to measure reuse vs pure cold starts.

maria: Great. AJ, can you pair with me on the evicted-key sampling code? I can run longer perf jobs and attach results.

aj: Yep — ping me when you start. I'll sketch the sampling endpoint and prometheus labels. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — I'll run a 6-hour long-context perf later today and drop the raw sample into the thread when done.

infra-bot: note: remember to add metrics instrumentation tests for new gauges/counters (integration with pushgateway) — infra checklist updated.
